decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Planning permission is required for the development because it is within a Conservation Area (see Part 24 A1(i) of the Town and Country Planning General Permitted Development Order 1995 (revised).

Condition : 2 - Planning Permission os refused for the following reasons:                                                                                                                                                                                        The proposed development would be an obtrusive feature forming an incongruous focal point to the vista down Grove Park Road. It would not preserve or enhance the character of Grove Park Conservation Area, contrary to policies ENV 1.1., ENV 1.2 and ENV 1.12 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of 12.5 m ultra slim streetworks monopole and outdoor equipment cabinet.
